correctness.rationale: An exact rational matrix identity proves entrywise-nonnegative kernels at n=3,4,5 for every h>=0. On every n-cycle the explicitly verified zero-mean discrete Green kernel gives A_n-dagger adjacent entry (n-1)(n-5)/(12n). Eigenmode expansion r(-h lambda)=1-12/(h lambda)+O(h^-2) gives a strictly negative adjacent entry for every n>=6 at sufficiently large h. At n=6, h=8 the entry is exactly -6584/580537. All eigenvalues stay positive and <=1, and constants are preserved. Standalone symbolic verification passed 16391 assertions; finite checks do not substitute for the all-n proof. No internal-stage or floating-point conclusion.

value.rationale: The precise last lattice size having all-step positivity for an A-stable fourth-order implicit rule is a natural complete maximum-principle classification, not an arbitrary numeric sample. The all-size adjacent Green-function coefficient identifies a structural obstruction and supplies a sharp asymptotic; even strictly positive scalar stability factors cannot ensure the physically relevant matrix property. These are useful reproducible benchmarks for deciding when positivity correction is needed.
